description: Found during jade-urd. INV6 says the running app cannot run DDL. The baseline revokes CREATE on schema public and the check covers CREATE TABLE, but Postgres grants TEMPORARY on each database to PUBLIC by default, so jade_app can CREATE TEMP TABLE (session-scoped, no persistent schema change). Fixing it is not a one-liner: REVOKE TEMPORARY ON DATABASE is per-database and is not copied by CREATE DATABASE ... TEMPLATE (datacl is per pg_database row), so it would belong in the runner/bootstrap (per target database) rather than a migration file, plus a check in baseline-migration.test.ts. Options: (a) accept as residual (temp objects are session-local; no data at risk); (b) runner revokes TEMPORARY from PUBLIC on its target database each run + test; (c) defer to a later security bead. Touches the migration runner -> planloop if (b).
notes: 2026-11-15 Mike: 'hwu: defer' (to a later security bead).
title: INV6: jade_app can CREATE TEMP TABLE via PUBLIC's default TEMPORARY privilege
